Dockling shows your upcoming events in shelf widgets.
Dockling shows your reminders in shelf widgets and can mark them as done.

Dockling controls music playback from shelf widgets, reads the media playing in browser tabs, reads the Mail inbox unread count for the Mail widget, and empties the Trash and ejects disks through Finder.
Dockling uses your location for the Weather widget.
Dockling reads your Desktop folder to show screenshots in the Screenshots widget.
Dockling reads your Downloads folder to show recent downloads in the Downloads widget.
Dockling reads the folder in Documents you chose for Photo Frame or screenshots to show its pictures.
Dockling reads the folder on an external disk you chose for Photo Frame to show its pictures.
Dockling reads the folder on a network volume you chose for Photo Frame to show its pictures.
When you change or mute an app's volume in the App Volume widget, Dockling taps that app's sound and plays it back at your level. Nothing is recorded or saved.
Dockling turns on the camera when you click Mirror in Quick Toggles, showing the picture in a small window. Nothing is recorded or saved, and the camera stops when you close the window.
Dockling uses the microphone to record voice memos when you press the Recorder widget's button. Recordings are saved only in the folder you choose.
